blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In his first week at the Bureau of Customs, Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza promoted 29 personnel to critical vacancies in major ports and offices through a merit-based selection process. According to a BOC statement on Tuesday, the promoted employees met the qualification requirements for their positions and went through a selection process administered by the Bureau’s Human Resource Merit Selection Board in line with Civil Service Commission rules on merit and fitness. As Mendoza said on Monday during his first flag-raising ceremony at the BOC, “Promotions, designations, and hirings will be based on performance, not on connections.” READ: […]...
